title: Zesty Dense Mediterranean Lentil Tagine
description: A sour and dense Mediterranean dish featuring ground ginger and bonito flakes, perfect for midnight cravings. This shojin-friendly recipe is a hearty and flavorful option for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the ground ginger, bonito flakes, and tomato paste, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the red lentils, lemon juice, and 2 cups of water to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Season the tagine with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
